## Specific task description

Task instruction: Move red block and green block to the center, then stack green block on red block.

Task description: Move the green block on the left and the red block on the right to the center of the table and stack them with red on the bottom and green on top.

Success criteria: Place both blocks centrally on the table, green stacked above red, with close horizontal centers and approximately one block height between them vertically. Both grippers must be open.

## Execution tips

- The block is rotated on the table. Align to grasp opposite flat faces, opening slightly wider than their separation. Place the pads around the upper-middle faces with ample contact, reducing corner grasps, table collisions and contact with the lower red block during stacking.
- The red block on the right is not fully visible. Adjust the viewing angle and confirm the fingers are outside the selected opposite faces before closing rather than inferring enclosure from image overlap.
- Keep block-bottom clearance above the table during transfer and orient in the central open area, avoiding the bottles, tray and tissue box behind. Stagger the arms' entry into the center to reduce mutual collisions.
- When placing the green block, keep its bottom approximately horizontal and lower in small steps above the red block. Confirm stable support before release and leave withdrawal clearance, avoiding sideways pushing of the red block at low height or releasing the green block in midair.
